text: I feel a sense of anticipation stepping into this space—its clean modernity and transparent walls seem to invite curiosity. Yet, the slightly odd tilt of my view (or presence) gives me the sensation of being a visitor, not yet grounded, as if hovering on the threshold of discovery. The presence of fire safety equipment reminds me of protocol and structure, yet my mind drifts toward the potential for new ideas and unexpected meaning within these walls.
